description: Find a company or fund in the global Legal Entity Identifier register (GLEIF): search by name (and country) or look up a 20-character LEI. Returns the legal name, former names, status, legal form, jurisdiction, business register number, legal and headquarters address, BIC codes, issue and renewal dates. For KYC and supplier checks, MiFID / EMIR reporting and clean company master data. Open data (CC0). Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.002 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/lei-company-lookup.

country.description: Only companies with a legal address in this country, ISO alpha-2, e.g. DE

limit.description: Max companies for a name search

name.description: Company name or words from it, e.g. Siemens

name: lei_company_lookup
title: LEI Company Lookup API - legal entity data from the global LEI register
